members.name: label
members.doc: Name of the fact, such as "Amount".

types.name: ApprovalCardProps
types.doc: A request for a person's decision before an agent acts. It states the action, keeps the fine print behind a details toggle, and once approved or rejected it settles into a resolved state: the icon turns into a drawn check or cross and the buttons give way to the outcome, with an undo.

members.name: title
members.doc: The action waiting for a decision, in one line.

members.name: summary
members.doc: A sentence or two on what will happen and why.

members.name: source
members.doc: Who is asking, shown above the title (an agent or a workflow name).

members.name: icon
members.doc: Icon of the request while it is pending.

members.name: details
members.doc: Facts shown when the details are open, as label and value rows.

members.name: children
members.doc: Extra content under the detail rows, such as a preview of the change.

members.name: defaultStatus
members.doc: Decision the card starts with when uncontrolled.

members.name: onStatusChange
members.doc: Called when the person approves, rejects or undoes.

members.name: detailsOpen
members.doc: Controlled open state of the details.

members.name: defaultDetailsOpen
members.doc: Whether the details start open when uncontrolled.

members.name: onDetailsOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the details toggle is pressed.

members.name: resolvedLabels
members.doc: Outcome text per decision, shown in the resolved state.

members.name: allowUndo
members.doc: Offers an undo in the resolved state that returns the card to pending.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
